# anchor meaning

What scores in this range MEAN — the calibration prose. NOT functional and range-open (PR #376 review): localizable prose may carry one meaning per language tag (sh:uniqueLang, SHACL) — a French and an English calibration coexist; two same-language meanings do not. Mandatory: an anchor without a meaning is just an interval.
